msg: Hey! Planning a bachelor party in Cartagena in February, there will be 6 of us from Texas. Three of the guys are certified and three have never dived. We want one day out on the water together. What's the deal price-wise for a group like ours? And can we pay with US credit cards? One of us would pay for everybody.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great day out in the Rosario Islands! Since you’re all going together, the certified divers can do the two-dive Fun Dives, while those who haven’t dived before can choose a Dive Mini Course, snorkeling, or come along on the boat as companions. The mini-course is an introductory experience, not a certification, so it’s a separate activity from certified diving.

I’m leaving the per-person prices below. Your group qualifies for the 10% group discount on eligible activities; it must be requested before paying, and it stacks with the online discount. The group discount doesn’t apply to PADI courses.

International guests pay in full by card on the website, and one person can pay for the group. A US credit card is a foreign card; the cardholder uses their passport as the ID document.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like to continue with the booking links for the activities you choose?

msg: Awesome. So three on the fun dives and three on the mini course, Saturday February 13th, leaving from Cartagena. How do we get that group discount exactly, and what's the final price per person? Also, it's a bachelor party, so would it be cool if we bring a cooler with some beers on the boat for after the dives?
reply:
It stacks with the online discount, for a total discount of 20% when booking online. I can’t calculate or confirm the final discounted prices here, but the per-person prices are listed below.

Please don’t bring or drink alcohol on the boat or during the activity, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD

*Group discount (5 people or more):* an extra 10%, on top of the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). It isn't automatic: ask the team before paying, or it's lost. It doesn't apply to PADI courses.

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather do more dives, there are *packages* of 3 or more; just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: Good call on asking: one of the certified guys, Mike, last dived about three years ago. The other two dived last summer. No beers, got it. So what does Mike need to do? And who do I talk to on your team to get the group discount before we pay?
reply:
Mike is still a certified diver and can join the certified dives. Since it’s been about three years, a refresher is normally required; it’s a short in-water review with an instructor, booked as a Dive Mini Course. If he has already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts. He should bring his certification card, and the refresher uses the course medical form.

For the group discount, contact our team and request it before anyone pays. The 10% group discount applies to your recreational diving and mini-course bookings and stacks with the 10% online discount, for 20% total when booking online. It isn’t applied automatically, and it can’t be added after payment. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor?

You'll also need:
• There is no theory to do beforehand: it is done there, on the day, with the instructor.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying

Keep in mind that the mini-course is a one-day introduction and does not certify you; to get certified there is the Open Water course (2 days, with a night on the islands).

msg: Okay. So on the 13th Mike does that short review in the morning and then joins the other two guys for their two dives the same day, right? How much does he pay in that case? And yes, please connect me with an advisor for the discount.
reply:
Yes—Mike remains a certified diver and can join the other two for the two dives after the instructor-led refresher. The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course and costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. The other certified divers’ Fun Dives are *178 USD per person* online. The group discount must be requested before payment; it adds 10% to the online discount for a total 20% online discount on eligible activities.

I'll connect you with an advisor from the Diving Planet team.
They will contact you shortly. Thanks! :)
